metadata.description: Personal Marketplace for development with claude code

plugins.name: tasks
plugins.description: Write and file tasks worth executing — a writing standard taken from the taskmgr store being filed into, and a user-invoked skill that turns the current conversation into an approved, dependency-ordered set of filed taskmgr tasks.

plugins.name: project-review
plugins.description: Read-only adversarial project reviews — codebase (consistency, structure, architecture, rules, over production and test code alike), one change against the rules the project wrote down, and docs — each a standalone lens that challenges the artifact against the project's own standards and returns a prioritized action list; the codebase lens also writes a standalone Markdown report with Mermaid diagrams and numbered deepening proposals

plugins.name: project-execute
plugins.description: Thin human-triggered skills that execute a project's own defined flows — run its tests, cut a release, analyze its monitoring data, review a change, drive the running product — plus an explainer that digests how the project handles a given topic from its own docs and an initializer that writes the agent-facing docs those flows are read from; every skill is grounded in what the project itself carries and invents nothing beyond it

plugins.name: challenge
plugins.description: On-demand adversarial passes over whatever is in front of you — grill stress-tests a plan or decision with pointed questions, kiss challenges accidental complexity and simplifies, are-you-sure re-checks finished work against what was actually asked, and what-do-you-mean re-pitches a message that did not land in 400 plain words; project-agnostic, applies to anything

plugins.name: github-releases
plugins.description: Language-agnostic GitHub release workflow with quality gates, semver, and release notes

plugins.name: claude-catppuccin
plugins.description: Visual style for Claude Code: Catppuccin color themes (Latte, Frappe, Macchiato, Mocha)

plugins.name: keep-awake-linux
plugins.description: Prevents Linux system sleep while Claude Code is actively working — releases automatically when idle or on session exit

plugins.name: html-visualization
plugins.description: Interactive HTML the user opens in a browser, then sends back to Claude — three command skills over a shared reference set, each rendering a different surface: question forms (html-visualize-ask), content for inline commenting (html-visualize-feedback), or static pages with an always-on footer for optional follow-up messages (html-visualize-page); a shared one-shot Node server captures the response and re-invokes Claude

plugins.name: project-auto-work
plugins.description: Unattended adversarial audits that work the project on their own and report back — test-tests, an empirical, language-independent test-suite strength audit that injects mutants, no-op edits, and delays to prove whether the tests actually detect bugs, and test-app, exploratory testing that launches the application, uses it for real, and judges what happened against the project's own user-facing docs and monitoring data; both report findings and proposals, neither writes code.

plugins.name: instruction-writing
plugins.description: Guidance for writing the artifacts an agent harness reads — project docs, skills, agents, workflow prompts — so they stay token-efficient and predictable; includes writing-project-docs: the canonical project-doc set, each file's ownership boundary, and a worked example of every file, and writing-skills: the vocabulary and principles for authoring and editing Claude Code skills
